lede: Denver Broncos carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#12 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Carolina Panthers +3.5 with a fair total of 44.0 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Carolina Panthers pass offence vs Denver Broncos pass defence, which sits −0.186 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
